plugins.name: jev-dispatch
plugins.description: Route agent tasks to the right harness, model, and effort level using a TypeSafe Jev judgment battery and a pure-code dispatch policy (MCP server + skill).

plugins.name: jev-gate
plugins.description: Gate agent tool calls before they run: plain-code lock rules ask before dangerous commands, a REUSE ledger stops unchanged expensive re-runs, and TypeSafe Jev judges the gray zone. Runs in shadow mode first (hooks + review skill).

plugins.name: spec-readiness-gate
plugins.description: Score a worker task spec before dispatch: a TypeSafe Jev battery checks the five contract fields and a pure-code policy returns dispatch, clarify (naming the weak fields), or escalate. Shadow mode first (MCP server + skill).

plugins.name: compact-nudge
plugins.description: Nudge the user to run /compact once the session context passes a token threshold, with a ready-to-edit /compact command drafted from the conversation. Claude Code only: function hooks on the terminal, a command-hook fallback on the desktop app and IDEs; never compacts on its own.

plugins.name: launch-video
plugins.description: Turn the current project or a website URL into a short, polished, shareable launch video using HyperFrames.

plugins.name: dev-workflows
plugins.description: Standard developer workflow for coding agents: clarify requirements before building, debug to the root cause, capture and recall project lessons, and run supervised multi-agent workflows (research swarms, parallel review, DAG builds) through the Orca CLI.
